title: Impact of British Inventor’s Announcement to Drop Electric Car Project in Singapore
what_it_is: Impact of British Inventor’s Announcement to Drop Electric Car Project in Singapore

sections.label: Dyson Singapore workforce and redeployment
sections.summary: Dyson has 20 electric vehicle employees out of 1,200 in Singapore, will redeploy them, and will grow its core business, battery technology and research.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Out of Dyson's 1,200-strong workforce in Singapore, 20 employees are from their electric vehicles business.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Dyson will redeploy the affected employees within the organisation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Although Dyson will no longer pursue its electric vehicles business, it will continue to grow its core business in Singapore, develop battery technology for consumer products and expand research and development in areas, such as sensors, robotics and artificial intelligence, which will also support the development of a smart mobility ecosystem.

sections.label: Dyson ends electric vehicles manufacturing
sections.summary: Dyson decided not to continue its electric vehicles manufacturing because it would not be commercially viable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Dyson decided not to continue with its electric vehicles manufacturing, this is a business that they were thinking of going into and later they decided that it would not be viable, commercially, for the company to continue.

sections.label: Incentives tied to electric vehicles project
sections.summary: Incentives tied to the electric vehicles project will not be given since the project has not taken place and investments have not been made.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The plans for the electric vehicles and any associated incentives that are tied to the electric vehicles project, if the electrical vehicles project is not going to continue, the incentives would not be given.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: I want to be clear that because the project has not taken place and the investments have not been made, the incentives have not been given.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, with the decision by Dyson not to continue with this electrical vehicles business, the incentives would, therefore, not be given for this project.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For other projects that Dyson has already started or is planning to expand some of its activities in Singapore, that is something we will look at separately.
